peers.keyOrigin: WireGuard app on Omar's Windows PC (empty tunnel); he sends only the public key

services.caveat: /mcp has no authentication, only a Host header check: a peer that reaches it can call every tool. Port 8789 on the vps is also held today by the WSL compute reverse tunnel (sshd, GatewayPorts yes), so the tunnel address would reach the WSL MCP. Owner decision required before apply (docs/operations/infra/MCP-A2A.md, findings 1 and 2).
runs with APHRODY_A2A_DRY_RUN=1 (messages recorded and answered, no peer CLI spawned); no authentication layer is declared for it

services.pendingReason: no training service with a declared port exists in the catalogs (managed llama ports are dynamic per run); the owner names the ports, then the routed ufw rules are generated

firewall.note: Rules carry the aphrody-wg-<peer> comment. scripts/ops/admin-access.ts of Shenron only deletes rules whose comment is shenron-admin, so the two never collide. The tunnel subnet is RFC 1918 outside 10.8.0.0/24: admin-access-host.ts skips it (no ufw, fail2ban, pg_hba or admin-IP entry).
